parameters.content:
## OTTO Food on Wheels -- Baileys Bot (AI Agent)

**Restaurant:** OTTO Food on Wheels
**Location:** Park Enclave Road, Islamabad
**Config:** botconfigs collection in MongoDB
**Webhook:** /webhook/otto-baileys

**Architecture:** AI Agent with tools
- get_menu: fetches menu on demand
- check_order_status: checks order by phone

**Requires:** Anthropic API credential in n8n

## Voice Note Flow

Baileys bridge saves audio to temp_audio/,
serves at localhost:3000/audio/filename.ogg
n8n downloads -> Whisper -> transcription
Cost tracked in BotConfig WHISPER_SPENT

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value: Always give answer in roman urdu . dont give answers in hindi like mujhe do zinger burger chahiye, delivery address Bahria Town hai.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Config').first().json.OWNER_JID, message: 'NEW ORDER -- OTTO

Customer: ' + $('Extract Message').first().json.profileName + '
Phone: ' + $('Extract Message').first().json.phone + '
Items: ' + JSON.stringify($('Process Reply').first().json.orderData?.items || []) + '
Total: Rs. ' + ($('Process Reply').first().json.orderData?.total || 0) + '
Address: ' + ($('Process Reply').first().json.orderData?.address || 'not provided') }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Config').first().json.OWNER_JID, message: 'HANDOFF NEEDED -- OTTO

Customer: ' + $('Extract Message').first().json.profileName + '
Phone: ' + $('Extract Message').first().json.phone + '
Reason: ' + ($('Process Reply').first().json.handoffData?.reason || 'unknown') + '
Last message: ' + $('Extract Message').first().json.messageBody + '

Bot is SILENT for this number. Set status to resolved in the Handoff collection to re-enable.' }) }}

parameters.name: get_menu
parameters.description: Get the full restaurant menu with all available items, categories, and prices. Call this whenever the customer asks about food, menu, items, prices, deals, or wants to order something.

parameters.name: check_order_status
parameters.description: Check the status of the customer's most recent order. Call this when the customer asks about their order status, delivery progress, or where their food is. You MUST pass the phone parameter.

value.phone: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('phone', `The customer's phone number for this order, exactly as given in the conversation`, 'string') }}
value.items: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('items', `A JSON array string of the order items about to be confirmed, using the exact same items and quantities you are about to place in the ORDER tag. Format: [{\"name\":\"Item Name\",\"qty\":1}]. Never leave this blank or send only some of the items.`, 'string') }}
value.total: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('total', `The total order amount in Rupees as a plain number, matching the total you are about to place in the ORDER tag`, 'string') }}
value.address: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('address', `The customer's delivery address for this order, exactly as given in the conversation. Leave empty only if the customer truly has not given an address yet.`, 'string') }}

parameters.text:
={{ '<context>
' +'<customer_phone>' + $json.phone + '</customer_phone>
' +'<reason_for_confirmation>' + $json.reason + '</reason_for_confirmation>
' +'<pending_order>' + JSON.stringify($json.pendingOrderPayload) + '</pending_order>
' +'<conversation_history>
' + $json.conversationHistory + '
</conversation_history>
' +'<customer_latest_reply>' + $json.customerMessage + '</customer_latest_reply>
' +'</context>

' +'<task>
' +'The customer was asked a duplicate-order confirmation question with exactly three options: confirm, cancel, or modify. Classify their latest reply into exactly one of these four outcomes:

' +'- confirmed: they clearly agree to proceed with the pending order exactly as it is (whether as the same order again, or explicitly agreeing it is a separate/different order).
' +'- declined: they clearly say no, cancel, or do not want this order, with no request to change anything.
' +'- modify: they want to change something about the order (items, size, flavor, quantity, address) before it is placed. This is a distinct outcome -- never classify a modify request as declined or unclear.
' +'- unclear: anything else -- a question, an unrelated message, or a reply that does not clearly address the confirmation at all.
' +'</task>

' +'<output_format>
' +'Reply with STRICT JSON only, no other text: {"result": "confirmed"} or {"result": "declined"} or {"result": "modify"} or {"result": "unclear"}.
' +'</output_format>' }}

={{ '<context>
' +'<customer_phone>' + $json.phone + '</customer_phone>
' +'<order_id>' + $json.orderId + '</order_id>
' +'<order_items>' + JSON.stringify($json.items) + '</order_items>
' +'<order_total>' + $json.total + '</order_total>
' +'<order_status>' + $json.status + '</order_status>
' +'<order_timestamp>' + $json.orderTimestamp + '</order_timestamp>
' +'<conversation_history>
' + $json.conversationHistory + '
</conversation_history>
' +'<customer_latest_reply>' + $json.customerMessage + '</customer_latest_reply>
' +'</context>

' +'<task>
' +'The customer was asked to confirm whether they want to cancel or modify an already-placed order (their most recent order, shown above), with exactly two options: confirm (cancel/change it -- staff will take over) or keep it as is. Classify their latest reply into exactly one of these three outcomes:

' +'- confirmed: they clearly want to proceed with cancelling or changing this specific placed order.
' +'- declined: they clearly want to keep the order as is, with no cancellation or change.
' +'- unclear: anything else -- a question, an unrelated message, or a reply that does not clearly address the confirmation at all.
' +'</task>

' +'<output_format>
' +'Reply with STRICT JSON only, no other text: {"result": "confirmed"} or {"result": "declined"} or {"result": "unclear"}.
' +'</output_format>' }}
